meta.question: 大学高等数学课程是否应该使用 AI Tutor（GPT-4 等生成式 AI 辅导工具）辅助学习？它是否真的有助于概念理解与独立解题，还是只是把学生变成拐杖使用者？

research_frame.question: 大学高等数学课程是否应该使用 AI Tutor（GPT-4 等生成式 AI 辅导工具）辅助学习？它是否真的有助于概念理解与独立解题，还是只是把学生变成拐杖使用者？
research_frame.success_condition: 护栏式 AI Tutor 在无 AI 独立考试与迁移任务上不劣于对照且概念理解改善，同时 AI 依赖风险受控；证据足以支撑一个有边界的试点而非全面铺开。

decision.decision_question: 大学高等数学课程是否应该使用 AI Tutor（GPT-4 等生成式 AI 辅导工具）辅助学习？
decision.target_population: university first-year science-and-engineering students taking advanced mathematics (calculus)
decision.target_context: one-semester university advanced-mathematics course, large cohort, TA support, offline
supported_claims: 护栏式（提示不给答案）AI Tutor 在练习任务上显著提升表现（Bastani: +127%），无护栏版本也有 +48% — E-001。
无护栏的通用生成式 AI 会损害移除 AI 后的独立解题能力（Bastani: 独立考试 -17%）— E-002。
护栏设计（教师设计的提示式 Tutor）基本消除负效应 — E-003。
AI 辅导工具能提升学习参与度与满意度，且学习结果不受损（Lee）— E-004, E-005。
uncertain_claims: AI Tutor 是否能在大学高数课程中提高长期概念理解与迁移能力 — 直接证据缺失。
Kazemitabaar 一周保持测试不显著是否延伸到更长周期 — E-006。
contradicted_claims: '只要给学生用生成式 AI 就能提高学习' 被 E-002 否定（无护栏 GPT Base 独立考试 -17%）。
decision.reason_for_disagreement: 分歧来自结果分离（练习任务表现 vs 独立考试）、工具设计（护栏 vs 无护栏）与人群/学科直接性（高中生数学、高中生英语、K-12 编程 vs 大学高数）。任务表现证据一致为正，但唯一测到独立学习结果的 RCT（Bastani）显示无护栏有害、护栏可消除负效应。
decision.methodology_summary: 三个来源均为随机对照（Bastani 近千人大规模 RCT、Lee 四班 RCT、Kazemitabaar 69 人受控实验），内部效度强；但对'大学高等数学 + 概念理解/长期学习'的直接性弱，且无大学数学学段的保留/迁移长周期证据。

outcome_specific_findings.independent_problem_solving: negative -17% without guardrails; neutralized with guardrails — E-002, E-003
outcome_specific_findings.engagement: positive: higher satisfaction and continued-use willingness — E-004
outcome_specific_findings.knowledge_gain: not harmed, one group significantly better — E-005
outcome_specific_findings.retention: neutral over 1 week in a programming context — E-006

decision.short_term_effect: 练习任务表现提升明显；无护栏时独立考试受损，护栏可消除负效应。
decision.long_term_effect: 无证据 — 无超过课程期末/一周的长期学习效应测量。
decision.transfer_effect: 无直接迁移证据；Bastani 的闭卷独立考试是最接近'去除 AI 后'的学习测量。
decision.risk_effect: AI 依赖与过度依赖风险真实存在（Bastani 中学生把 GPT Base 当拐杖抄答案）；护栏设计可显著降低该风险。

applicability.suitable_for: 大学高数课堂的护栏式 AI Tutor 试点
applicability.not_suitable_for: 无护栏的通用 AI 直接进入课堂
required_conditions: 只给提示不给答案的护栏策略
无 AI 独立考试与迁移测试

what_can_be_claimed: 护栏设计（提示而非答案）决定生成式 AI 辅导工具的学习效应方向 — 无护栏有害，护栏基本消除负效应。
AI 辅导工具能显著提升练习任务表现（+48%~+127%）。
AI 辅导工具可提升参与度与满意度，且学习结果不受损（至少在现有研究覆盖的学科/学段内）。
无护栏的通用生成式 AI 会损害独立解题能力。
what_cannot_be_claimed: AI Tutor 在大学高数课程中提高长期概念理解或迁移能力 — 直接证据缺失。
AI Tutor 对任何学段/学科/学生都有效 — 人群与学科直接性不足。
任务表现提升等于学习提升 — Bastani 内嵌对照已证伪。
missing_evidence: 大学数学（高数/微积分）课堂的 RCT，含无 AI 独立考试与保持/迁移测试。
同一课程内对护栏 vs 无护栏 AI 使用策略的对照研究。
超越一个学期的 AI 依赖与学习保持数据。
decision.decision_rationale: 护栏式 AI Tutor 在练习表现、参与度上证据积极，无护栏有害有实证；但'大学高数 + 长期理解'的直接证据缺失 → 有边界、有评估、带停止条件的护栏式试点，而非全面采用。
exceeds_evidence_boundary: 'AI Tutor 提高大学高数学习效果' — 超出：大学高数直接学习效应证据缺失。
'AI Tutor 无风险' — 超出：E-002 显示无护栏有害。
'AI Tutor 对所有学生有效' — 超出：学段/学科不匹配。

claims.claim: Access to GPT-4 during practice substantially improves practice problem performance (+48% for unguarded GPT Base, +127% for guardrailed GPT Tutor), but these task-performance gains do not transfer to independent exam performance.

Students using unguarded GPT-4 (GPT Base, general chat) performed 17% worse on the independent exam than the control group despite higher practice performance — unguarded generative AI harms learning.
Guardrail design of the AI tutor (hints and guidance instead of direct answers, teacher-informed prompts) largely eliminated the negative learning effect on the independent exam.
Replacing traditional homework with an interactive GPT-4 homework tutor produced higher student satisfaction and greater willingness to continue using the tool.
Learning outcomes were not harmed when homework was replaced by the GPT-4 interactive tutor, and one of the treatment groups showed significantly better learning gains.

One week after training, retention differences between the AI-assistant group and the baseline group were not statistically significant — indirect evidence for a similar AI tutoring tool, but with a null learning effect in a different subject and age group.

evidence.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics
evidence.subject: mathematics
evidence.population: nearly a thousand (approx. 950) high school mathematics students in Turkey
evidence.outcome_measure: practice problem performance during in-class study sessions
evidence.claim: Access to GPT-4 during practice substantially improves practice problem performance (+48% for unguarded GPT Base, +127% for guardrailed GPT Tutor), but these task-performance gains do not transfer to independent exam performance.
evidence.method: large-scale randomized controlled trial, practice phase followed by closed-book independent exam

evidence.subject: mathematics

evidence.outcome_measure: closed-book independent exam without AI access after practice phase
evidence.claim: Students using unguarded GPT-4 (GPT Base, general chat) performed 17% worse on the independent exam than the control group despite higher practice performance — unguarded generative AI harms learning.
evidence.method: large-scale randomized controlled trial, practice phase then closed-book independent exam

evidence.subject: english_language

evidence.title: Studying the effect of AI Code Generators on Supporting Novice Learners in Introductory Programming
evidence.subject: introductory_programming
evidence.population: 69 novice programmers ages 10-17 with no prior text-based programming experience
evidence.outcome_measure: retention test one week after training
evidence.claim: One week after training, retention differences between the AI-assistant group and the baseline group were not statistically significant — indirect evidence for a similar AI tutoring tool, but with a null learning effect in a different subject and age group.
evidence.method: controlled experiment with random assignment and delayed retention test

control_group.note: All three sources include a no-AI comparison condition.

randomization.note: Bastani 2025 (large RCT), Lee 2025 (four-class RCT) and Kazemitabaar 2023 (randomized controlled experiment) all use randomized assignment.

pre_test.note: Bastani 2025 measures baseline covariates; Kazemitabaar 2023 has a pre-study evaluation; Lee 2025 baseline not fully detailed.

post_test.note: Immediate post-measures present in all sources (practice exams, homework assessments, programming tests).

retention_test.note: Kazemitabaar 2023 has a 1-week retention test; Bastani 2025 has no delayed test; Lee 2025 covers course length but no delayed retention beyond the course.

transfer_test.note: Bastani 2025's closed-book independent exam is the strongest transfer-adjacent measure (AI removed); no full novel-topic transfer task in any study.

sample_bias.note: Bastani 2025 ~950 students; Lee 2025 four intact classes; Kazemitabaar 2023 small (69) but explicitly randomized.

self_selection.note: Random assignment in all three studies limits self-selection.

measurement_validity.note: Bastani 2025 correctly separates practice/task performance from independent exam learning; but no study directly measures university mathematics concept understanding.

confounders.note: Education-level mismatch (high school / K-12 vs university) is the dominant issue; prior ability interacts with AI benefit in Kazemitabaar 2023.

instructor_effect.note: Lee 2025 runs four intact classes — class/instructor effects possible; Bastani 2025 in-class sessions may carry teacher effects.

novelty_effect.note: Short interventions and new tool exposure may inflate engagement; not controlled in any study.

tool_version_effect.note: Each study used one GPT/Codex version; rapid model iteration limits durability of findings.

ai_usage_policy.note: Bastani 2025 explicitly contrasts unguarded (GPT Base) vs guardrailed (GPT Tutor) usage policies — directly informative for policy design.

dropout.note: Attrition not systematically reported across all studies.

task_vs_learning_guard.measured_construct: practice/task performance vs independent exam performance
task_vs_learning_guard.note: Bastani 2025 provides an embedded contrast: +48%/+127% practice performance coexisted with -17% independent exam performance for the unguarded arm — practice performance must NOT be equated with learning.

limitations: No study directly targets university advanced-mathematics (calculus) students.
Subject/level directness is insufficient: high-school math (Bastani 2025), high-school English (Lee 2025), K-12 programming (Kazemitabaar 2023).
No retention beyond 1 week (Kazemitabaar 2023) or beyond course end (Lee 2025); no long-term transfer evidence.
无护栏 GPT Base 的负效应 (-17%) 说明工具设计护栏是决定因素，直接照搬通用聊天工具进入大学课堂不可行。
suggestions: Treat all conclusions as indirect until a university-mathematics study exists.
Design the pilot's guardrailed tutor on Bastani 2025's GPT Tutor design (hints, not answers).
Include a no-AI independent exam and a retention/transfer test in the evaluation plan.
Vary the AI usage policy within the pilot to isolate guardrail effects.

intervention.target_learners: university first-year science-and-engineering students in advanced mathematics (calculus), large cohort
learning_goals: independently solve routine and non-routine calculus problems without AI
understand core concepts: limits, derivatives, integrals and their geometric meaning
use the AI Tutor critically as a hint-and-explanation aid, not an answer machine

phase_1.name: Phase 1 — 独立解题基线 (Independent Baseline)
activities: 无 AI 独立解题基线测验
前两周作业完全在无 AI 环境下完成
phase_1.ai_usage_rule: AI Tutor 禁用，仅允许教材与讲义
phase_1.outcome_check: 基线概念理解与独立解题测量

phase_2.name: Phase 2 — 提示式护栏 Tutor 辅导练习 (Hint-only Guardrailed Tutor)
activities: 第 3-4 周：引入护栏式 AI Tutor 辅导练习
Tutor 只给提示与思路引导，不直接给答案
phase_2.ai_usage_rule: Tutor 只提供提示/分步引导/错误定位；禁止给出完整解答
phase_2.outcome_check: 练习完成率、求助类型记录与中期无 AI 测验

phase_3.name: Phase 3 — 结构化合作 (Structured Collaboration)
activities: 第 5-7 周：先自己作答，再对照 Tutor 提示比对与订正
每次练习后书面写出与 Tutor 提示的差异及自己的错因
phase_3.ai_usage_rule: 必须先行独立尝试 10 分钟以上才能向 Tutor 求助；每次求助后提交反思记录
phase_3.outcome_check: 每周作业正确率与反思记录质量

phase_4.name: Phase 4 — 无 AI 独立考试与迁移任务 (No-AI Independent Exam & Transfer)
activities: 第 8 周：无 AI 环境下的独立考试
新增题型（未在练习中出现）的迁移任务
phase_4.ai_usage_rule: 考试与迁移任务全程禁止 AI 访问
phase_4.outcome_check: 独立考试得分、迁移任务得分、AI 依赖指标

intervention.ai_usage_policy: 明确护栏：AI Tutor 只允许提供提示、思路引导与错误诊断，禁止直接给出答案或完整解题过程；未先行独立尝试不得求助；直接复制 Tutor 输出视为学术诚信违规。
intervention.teacher_role: 设计护栏提示词与评分量规；每周审阅使用日志与反思记录；主持反思复盘
intervention.student_role: 按阶段规则使用 Tutor；先自答再求助；提交反思记录；诚实报告求助频率
intervention.reflection_requirement: 每次使用 Tutor 后书面说明：我卡在哪里、Tutor 给了什么提示、我如何用它自己完成；每阶段提交一份反思小结
intervention.assessment: 无 AI 基线测验、中期无 AI 测验、期末无 AI 独立考试、迁移任务、练习完成率、反思记录质量
risk_control: 护栏策略复刻 Bastani 2025 GPT Tutor 设计（提示不给答案）
无 AI 独立考试与迁移任务防止练习表现掩盖学习缺失
每周审阅使用日志识别'抄答案'拐杖行为
AI 依赖与虚假信心指标阈值监控
stop_conditions: 无 AI 独立考试成绩较同校历史基线下降超过 10%
迁移任务得分显著低于对照组
反思记录中出现大量直接复制 Tutor 输出（学术诚信违规超过 20%）
AI 依赖指标连续两周超过预设阈值
教师/助教工作量不可持续

evaluation.research_question: 在大学高等数学课程中，护栏式 AI Tutor（只给提示不给答案）是否能在保持/提升参与度的同时，提高（或至少不损害）独立解题能力与概念理解，且不增加 AI 依赖？

groups.treatment: 使用 4 阶段护栏式 AI Tutor 政策的教学班
groups.comparison: 匹配教学班：不使用 AI Tutor，仅传统教材+习题课（同教师同材料）

evaluation.baseline: 第 1 周无 AI 独立解题基线测验（概念理解 + 独立解题 + 完成时间）
evaluation.post_test: 第 8 周无 AI 环境下的独立考试（概念理解与独立解题）
evaluation.retention_test: 第 14-16 周（期末或延迟 4-8 周）无 AI 保持测验
evaluation.transfer_test: 第 8 周新增题型（未在练习中出现、需迁移运用）的无 AI 迁移任务
process_metrics: AI Tutor 使用日志：求助次数、提示类型、每次求助前的独立尝试时长
求助类型分类（实质求助 vs 答案抄写）
反思记录提交率与质量评分
learning_metrics: 无 AI 独立考试成绩（独立解题）
练习任务表现（单独报告，不与学习指标混同）
risk_metrics: AI 依赖指标（求助后能否独立复现解题过程）
过度依赖（求助频率高于阈值、独立尝试时长过短）
虚假信心（测验前自评信心 vs 实际得分差异）
学术诚信违规（直接复制 Tutor 输出）次数
evaluation.analysis_plan: 预注册的基线校正比较（ANCOVA）：treatment vs comparison 在无 AI 独立考试、保持测验、迁移任务上的差异；练习任务表现单独建模并明确标注为 task performance，不与学习效应混同；按学生先验水平与求助行为做亚组分析；在第 3、5、7 周检查停止条件。
evaluation.success_threshold: 治疗组在无 AI 独立考试与迁移任务上不劣于对照组（差距 ≤5%）且概念理解不降，同时参与度（engagement）显著高于对照组、AI 依赖指标低于阈值；若无 AI 独立解题下降 >10%，无论练习表现多好均判试点失败。
stop_conditions: 无 AI 独立考试或迁移任务较对照下降 >10%
学术诚信违规出现在 >20% 的提交中
AI 依赖指标连续两周超阈值
